items.name: Nine-document baseline refresh is explicit and bounded
items.notes: All six product and three feature documents must be incrementally refreshed; no other document is authorized by default.

items.name: CR161 will be reframed without rewriting its closed history
items.notes: CR162 changes the current baseline and later records CR161 historical_baseline_status=reframed; it does not reopen CP3/CP7/CP8.

items.name: Design, implementation and runtime boundaries remain deny-by-default
items.notes: No HLD/ADR change, code/test implementation, FDR/PBO/DSR/OOS/TCA/capacity computation, data access, runtime or publish action is in scope.

items.name: Generic CP8 baseline-refresh checker is separated from the correction
items.notes: A generic Meta Flow CP8 checker change is a separate candidate and is not silently implemented in this documentation correction.

accepted_human_decisions.summary: Approve incremental refresh of all nine promised CR161 baseline documents.
accepted_human_decisions.recommended: Refresh all nine documents so the formal CR161 commitment is fully met.
alternatives: Refresh only six product documents and defer feature documents.
Leave the baseline unchanged and retain the finding as a follow-up candidate.

accepted_human_decisions.summary: Correct current baselines through CR162 while preserving CR161 as closed historical delivery.
accepted_human_decisions.recommended: Mark CR161 reframed after verification; do not reopen or rewrite its CP3/CP7/CP8 history.
alternatives: Reopen CR161 and repeat governance gates.
Leave CR161 historical status unchanged without a current-baseline reframe.

accepted_human_decisions.summary: Keep the generic CP8 product-baseline-refresh checker as a separate candidate.
accepted_human_decisions.recommended: Track it as FU-CR162-001 without expanding this correction into Meta Flow implementation.
alternatives: Add checker implementation to CR162 and reroute through CP3-CP6.
